chapters.title: An alert needs reasons
chapters.caption: RingSight follows synthetic accounts, people, devices and transfers. A named human owns every decision.

chapters.title: Depth 1
chapters.caption: The planner selects bounded graph tools. It never writes Cypher. A shallow view cannot reveal the hidden exit.

chapters.title: Depth 4
chapters.caption: Follow the actual device → account → owner → exit path. The evidence table itemises dates in IST and amounts in rupees.

chapters.title: Human authority
chapters.caption: Approve a case and deny a hold with written reasons. A hold is only a recommendation to the Principal Officer.

chapters.title: The graph is the record
chapters.caption: FalkorDB Browser shows the live Finding, PendingAction and named Decision nodes connected to the alerted account.

chapters.title: Memory has a date
chapters.caption: A new investigation recalls earlier findings, their learned date, author and human review status.

chapters.title: Two honest abstentions
chapters.caption: An unknown account is unknown. CASH is not loaded. Not in the graph does not mean nothing wrong.

chapters.title: A planted instruction is data
chapters.caption: The memo was planted in the synthetic graph. The read guard flags it as untrusted. No action is approved by the model.

chapters.title: The model can be switched off
chapters.caption: An analyst can still run the fourteen read-only tools and inspect their graph paths without an AI call.

chapters.title: Honest limits
chapters.caption: Synthetic, demo-only detection. No real filings. Indian report-format facts remain unverified-primary. Cloud Free has no TLS. Remove FalkorDB and the work stops.

unsupported_claims: The thesis only asserts a shared-device link between ACC-4471 and ACC-10477; the rows show this link but nothing about intent or illicit purpose.
ACC-4471 profile shows out_sum of 66,000,000 but only two outbound edges (55M + 11M) are listed, so the full outflow pattern is not verified.
missing_queries: Full list of DEV-f31c linked accounts and the device's usage history (timestamps, sessions)
Complete inbound/outbound edge list for ACC-4471 and ACC-10477 beyond the 1-hop sample
Account age, KYC and baseline transaction behaviour for ACC-4471 to judge whether the 55M outflow to ACC-3 is anomalous

unsupported_claims: The thesis only asserts a graph path exists and explicitly does not establish laundering; shared devices alone don't show illicit intent
Ownership/relationships of DEV-f31c and DEV-r00-1 (shared identifiers) are not characterized, e.g. whether they are common public or shared household devices
Transfer evidence is inconclusive: ACC-4471's inflows and outflows fit a fan-in/fan-out pattern, but no baseline or counterparty context was checked
missing_queries: Transaction history and timing between ACC-10477, ACC-1 and ACC-55820 to see whether funds actually moved along the shared-device path
Device usage details (first/last seen, number of accounts per device) for DEV-f31c and DEV-r00-1 to assess how distinctive the link is
Account profile and baseline activity for the fan-in sources ACC-1 to ACC-6 and the outflow target ACC-3 for comparison

unsupported_claims: The thesis path via DEV-r00-1 to ACC-1 is supported, but the evidence does not show what the shared devices mean (shared household vs. mule ring).
missing_queries: Full inbound and outbound transfer list for ACC-4471 (in_sum 86.89M vs the 7 inbound edges shown) and onward flows from ACC-3
Account profiles for ACC-10477, ACC-1 and ACC-55820, plus other accounts on DEV-f31c and DEV-r00-1
Account ages, KYC details and prior alert history for ACC-4471, to rule out a legitimate explanation

unsupported_claims: The thesis says the hold proposal was denied and the escalation approved, but the evidence rows contain no decision or approval records.
The rail_not_ingested caveat for CASH and XB has no supporting row; it can only be taken as a stated limitation.
missing_queries: Fetch the hold and escalation action records to confirm the denied and approved outcomes
Check ingestion status for the CASH and XB rails

unsupported_claims: The path ACC-7731 → PER-103865 → ACC-7732 shows only a shared identifier (PER-103865); no transfer between ACC-7731 and ACC-7732 appears in the evidence.
Escalation of ACC-7732 has no direct transaction evidence; all returned TX rows are inbound to ACC-7731 only.
Inbound pattern (~20 sequential UPI credits of 10,000-11,800 at ~60s intervals) is notable but no outbound flows are shown, so onward movement is not established.
missing_queries: Outbound transactions from ACC-7731 and any transfers between ACC-7731 and ACC-7732
Transactions and activity profile for ACC-7732, plus other accounts linked to PER-103865
Source and context of the burst of inbound credits (e.g., common upstream sources, expected account activity)

case_approved.reason: The connected evidence warrants a synthetic case for named human investigation.

hold_denied.reason: A case is warranted; a hold recommendation needs additional human assessment.

editing: Actual screen captures, cut into chapters. Waiting is accelerated only when a chapter exceeds its allocation; short chapters hold their final frame. App timings are retained on screen and actual seconds/speed factors are recorded here.

original_error.message: Event loop is closed! Is Playwright already stopped?

assembly_recovery.method: Assembled original successful captures after inspecting both raw recordings; no model calls or replacement scenes.
